Linear representation of all trails and pathways within the City of Brampton. Includes multi use pathways beside roadways as well as in parks and conservation areas.

Existing Facilities identify the active transportation infrastructure currently in place within the city, including pathways, trails, cycling routes, and other facilities that support walking, cycling, and rolling. Together, these facilities form the foundation of Brampton’s active transportation network and provide connections to local destinations and regional routes.
